predicate.label: has spokesperson
predicate.definition: Organization or principal X has person Y serving as its spokesperson.
ambiguous: dateline/location replacing the principal or person
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: inverse spokesperson_for with correct attachment; organization-modifying spokesman and appositive person. rationale: Possessive/nominal spokesman-appositive paths and say-at spokesmen dominate, ordered institution to spokesperson.
